title: Uniform norm lower bound
statement:
Let $n,d$ be nonnegative integers with $6d\leq n$, and let $F$ be the level-$3d$ polynomial on the discrete cube of dimension $n$. If $M(n,d)$ denotes the multinomial coefficient with six entries equal to $d$ and a seventh equal to $n-6d$, then
\[
\left(\frac{M(n,d)}{\binom{n}{3d}^{2}}\right)^{1/4}\|F\|_2\leq \|F\|_4,
\]
where the norms are uniform norms on the cube.
